##### Project general facts

The Estates Residences is a low-density, gated community by SODIC, combining apartments, duplexes, villas, twin homes and townhomes within a landscape planned by an international master planner. The modern countryside architecture gives each building its own look and colour palette, with large windows bringing natural light and imaginative views into every home.

Parks with lakes, playgrounds and barbecue areas are linked by green spines lined with shops, cafés, sports courts and play areas, while a ring road keeps cars away from pedestrian paths. The Grounds sports hub offers tennis and paddle tennis courts, a football pitch, a jogging track, a skating arena, pools and a gym, and a supermarket, pharmacy, laundromat, medical centre and veterinary clinic cover daily needs within the community.

Apartments come fully finished with air conditioning and private rooftops, and duplexes feature double-height ceilings, private entrances and landscaped gardens. Villas feature nanny rooms and roof terraces, finished with marble, porcelain and oak veneer doors, while twin homes and townhomes also come fully finished.

##### Location description and benefits

New Zayed is a prime location in West Cairo, neighbouring Sheikh Zayed and close to SODIC West. The district runs parallel to the Dabaa Road and is accessible to the Cairo–Alex highway.

Sphinx International Airport is close by, and the Grand Egyptian Museum is within easy reach. Juhayna Square and the services of the surrounding Sheikh Zayed are a short drive away.

West Cairo brings together residential communities, retail and leisure destinations linked by the Cairo–Alex highway and the Dabaa Road, making the area convenient for getting around Greater Cairo.
